significance: Founded by the Sri Ayyappa Seva Samajam, formed in 1976 out of the vilakku pooja gatherings of Shanti Colony, and consecrated on 13 May 1984 by a former chief priest of Sabarimala. Built to shastraic rule in Kerala style with a west-facing sanctum, it won the Mylapore Academy award for best-maintained temple in Chennai in 1998.
